chapter: The Grid (levels 71-80, the neon wireframe world of mathematical solids) - regenerated on the desert's ember model (the owner, 2026-10-11, #824): a lead line the ear can follow, its identity in the mid range, the drive carried by arrangement rather than by noise and sub bass; the family's electronic dance root kept
purpose: Master of Game/Music/pulse-acid.ogg: written from this file by Tools/MusicBake --tracks --masters <this folder>, brought to the themes' loudness, peaks held under full scale, Ogg Vorbis. The master stays outside the repository (C:/Users/panrd/AI/output/masters-824-chosen on the desktop, with its .raw.wav; every candidate in masters-824); this sidecar is committed beside the .ogg.
generator: ACE-Step 1.5 (acestep.cpp v0.0.5), local, AMD RX 6900 XT via Vulkan -- batch-pulse.ps1 -> generate-music.ps1 -Loop -NoCotCaption
format: 48000 Hz, 32-bit float PCM, stereo -- 48 kHz is the model's fixed native rate

request.caption: Melodic acid house instrumental for a neon wireframe world of glowing geometric shapes: a catchy, memorable acid synth riff you can hum, warm and rounded, loud and upfront in the mid range, a warm analog synth lead melody of many notes answering it, a tight warm four-on-the-floor kick, a deep round snare and warm toms playing throughout from the first bar, soft dark percussion, a warm mid-range bass line, warm chord stabs and pads, building into a big glowing peak with warm wide synth chords, hypnotic, playful and driving, warm mid-forward mix, modern polished production with soft, warm, rolled-off highs, wide stereo mix with instruments panned left and right, stereo delays, spacious reverb, no vocals

chosen.why: the one acid render of seventeen inside ember on every column with a clean loop: 14.5 % in 200 Hz-2 kHz, 11.7 % in 300 Hz-4 kHz, 1.4 % above 6 kHz (old 6.2 %), tonal mid 69 % (old 17 %), 3.87 held-note changes/s (old 1.95), a 61 s loop in time (context 0.88, crossfade r 0.93 against 0.95, spectrum cos 0.95), 5 % of it under -10 dB, wrap step +1.3 dB (p38). Round 3's brief (no cymbal named, ride, crash and hi-hats in the negative, soft rolled-off highs) rendered again. c11 has the fullest mids of the family (34.5 %) and a clean seam but 2.8 % above 6 kHz; c8 (1.1 %) left a 23 % hole and c14 (1.5 %) a 28.6 dB dropout
chosen.how: every candidate measured with Tools/Generation/measure-music.py --reference ember in one run (band shares, tonal mid, mid flatness, held-note changes, tempo wander, wrap step) beside the loop cut's own check, the hole share (the loop more than 10 dB under its loud level), the breakdown dip and the stereo correlation; a seam below its own rhythm, a hole over 15 %, a 2 s dropout more than 20 dB down, a wrap step of 10 dB or more or at or above p97 of the loop's own steps, a seam spectrum cosine under 0.3 or a loop under 30 s ruled a candidate out; the table is on #824
